(My first assignment was quieter than I expected.)
data.Thai: (จุดประจำการแรกของฉันเงียบกว่าที่คิดไว้.)
data.Vietnamese: (Nơi được phân công đầu tiên của tôi yên tĩnh hơn tôi nghĩ.)
data.Indonesian: (Penugasan pertamaku ternyata lebih tenang dari yang kupikir.)

data.Korean: 여기가 시에스 방어 요새야? 몬스터가 거의 안 나온다더니, 진짜로 조용하네.
data.English: Is this Cies Defense Fortress? They said monsters almost never appear here, and it really is quiet.
data.Thai: ที่นี่คือป้อมป้องกันซีเอสเหรอ? ได้ยินว่ามอนสเตอร์แทบไม่ออกมาเลย เงียบจริงด้วย.
data.Vietnamese: Đây là pháo đài phòng thủ Cies à? Nghe nói quái vật hầu như không xuất hiện, đúng là yên tĩnh thật.
data.Indonesian: Ini Benteng Pertahanan Cies? Katanya monster hampir tidak pernah muncul, dan memang tenang sekali.

data.English: Are you the Commander and the Guardians?
data.Thai: ท่านคือผู้บัญชาการและเหล่าผู้พิทักษ์ใช่ไหมครับ?
data.Vietnamese: Ngài là Chỉ huy và các Hộ vệ phải không ạ?
data.Indonesian: Apakah Anda Komandan dan para Penjaga?

data.Korean: 시에스 방어 요새에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
data.English: Welcome to Cies Defense Fortress.
data.Thai: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ป้อมป้องกันซีเอสครับ.
data.Vietnamese: Chào mừng đến pháo đài phòng thủ Cies.
data.Indonesian: Selamat datang di Benteng Pertahanan Cies.

data.Korean: 환영해 줘서 고마워. 오자마자 일 이야기를 해서 미안한데, 안내를 부탁할게.
data.English: Thanks for the welcome. Sorry to talk business right away, but please show us around.
data.Thai: ขอบคุณที่ต้อนรับนะ. ขอโทษที่มาถึงก็พูดเรื่องงานเลย แต่ช่วยนำทางให้หน่อย.
data.Vietnamese: Cảm ơn đã đón tiếp. Vừa đến đã nói chuyện công việc thì ngại quá, nhưng nhờ anh hướng dẫn giúp.
data.Indonesian: Terima kasih atas sambutannya. Maaf baru datang sudah membahas tugas, tapi tolong pandu kami.

data.English: This is Serah, and this is Noah.
data.Thai: ทางนี้คือเซราห์ และทางนี้คือโนอา.
data.Vietnamese: Đây là Serah, còn đây là Noah.
data.Indonesian: Ini Serah, dan ini Noah.

data.Korean: 반가워. 전열을 맡고 있는 세라야. 관문 쪽 확인은 내가 먼저 볼게.
data.English: Nice to meet you. I am Serah, in charge of the front line. I will check the gate area first.
data.Thai: ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก. ฉันเซราห์ รับหน้าที่แนวหน้า. ฉันจะตรวจดูฝั่งประตูก่อน.
data.Vietnamese: Rất vui được gặp. Tôi là Serah, phụ trách tiền tuyến. Tôi sẽ kiểm tra khu cổng trước.
data.Indonesian: Senang bertemu. Aku Serah, bertugas di garis depan. Aku akan memeriksa area gerbang dulu.

data.Korean: 노아야. 멀리서 보이는 움직임은 내가 먼저 확인해 둘게.
data.English: I am Noah. I will check any distant movement first.
data.Thai: ฉันโนอา. ถ้ามีความเคลื่อนไหวไกล ๆ ฉันจะตรวจดูก่อน.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Noah. Tôi sẽ kiểm tra trước mọi chuyển động ở xa.
data.Indonesian: Aku Noah. Aku akan lebih dulu memeriksa pergerakan yang terlihat dari jauh.

data.English: And these are Alice and Spayin.
data.Thai: แล้วทางนี้คืออลิซกับสไปน์.
data.Vietnamese: Còn đây là Alice và Spayin.
data.Indonesian: Dan ini Alice serta Spayin.

data.Korean: 엘리스야. 신호석 확인과 마법 지원을 맡고 있어. 보기보다 꼼꼼한 편이니까 걱정하지 마.
data.English: I am Alice. I handle signal stone checks and magic support. I am more thorough than I look, so do not worry.
data.Thai: ฉันอลิซ. รับหน้าที่ตรวจศิลาสัญญาณกับสนับสนุนเวทมนตร์. ฉันละเอียดกว่าที่เห็นนะ ไม่ต้องห่วง.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Alice. Tôi phụ trách kiểm tra đá tín hiệu và hỗ trợ ma pháp. Tôi kỹ tính hơn vẻ ngoài đấy, nên đừng lo.
data.Indonesian: Aku Alice. Aku menangani pemeriksaan batu sinyal dan dukungan sihir. Aku lebih teliti dari kelihatannya, jadi jangan khawatir.

data.Korean: 스파인이야. 회복을 맡고 있어. 아프면 바로 말해줘.
data.English: I am Spayin. I handle healing. If you are hurt, tell me right away.
data.Thai: ฉันสไปน์. รับหน้าที่รักษา. ถ้าเจ็บก็รีบบอกทันทีนะ.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Spayin. Tôi phụ trách hồi phục. Nếu bị đau thì nói ngay nhé.
data.Indonesian: Aku Spayin. Aku bertugas menyembuhkan. Kalau terluka, segera bilang.

data.English: I am Demian, captain of the Cies Fortress Guard.
data.Thai: ผมคือเดเมียน หัวหน้าทหารยามป้อมซีเอสครับ.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi là Demian, đội trưởng lính gác pháo đài Cies.
data.Indonesian: Saya Demian, kapten Penjaga Benteng Cies.

data.Korean: 앞으로 잘 부탁해, 데미안. 도착 전에 확인할 업무는 전달받았어.
data.English: We will be counting on you, Demian. We were briefed on what to check before arriving.
data.Thai: ฝากตัวด้วยนะ เดเมียน. ก่อนมาถึง พวกเราได้รับเรื่องที่ต้องตรวจแล้ว.
data.Vietnamese: Nhờ anh giúp đỡ, Demian. Trước khi đến, chúng tôi đã nhận được danh sách việc cần kiểm tra.
data.Indonesian: Kami mengandalkanmu, Demian. Sebelum tiba, kami sudah menerima tugas yang perlu diperiksa.

data.Korean: 세라는 관문 검문소를 확인해 줘. 노아는 망루에서 숲길을 봐줘.
data.English: Serah, check the gate checkpoint. Noah, watch the forest road from the tower.
data.Thai: เซราห์ ตรวจด่านหน้าประตูด้วย. โนอา ดูทางป่าจากหอคอยนะ.
data.Vietnamese: Serah, hãy kiểm tra trạm gác cổng. Noah, quan sát đường rừng từ tháp canh nhé.
data.Indonesian: Serah, periksa pos gerbang. Noah, awasi jalan hutan dari menara.

data.Korean: 엘리스는 신호석을 확인해 주고, 스파인은 물자 보관소를 봐줄래?
data.English: Alice, check the signal stones. Spayin, can you check the supply storage?
data.Thai: อลิซ ตรวจศิลาสัญญาณให้หน่อย. สไปน์ ช่วยดูคลังเสบียงได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Alice, kiểm tra đá tín hiệu giúp tôi. Spayin, cậu xem kho vật tư được chứ?
data.Indonesian: Alice, periksa batu sinyal. Spayin, bisa cek gudang persediaan?

data.Korean: 데미안, 네 사람에게 안내할 인원을 붙여줄 수 있을까?
data.English: Demian, can you assign guides to the four of them?
data.Thai: เดเมียน ช่วยจัดคนไปนำทางทั้งสี่คนได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Demian, anh có thể bố trí người dẫn đường cho bốn người họ không?
data.Indonesian: Demian, bisa tugaskan orang untuk memandu mereka berempat?

data.English: Understood. I will assign guides at once.
data.Thai: รับทราบครับ. จะจัดกำลังนำทางทันที.
data.Vietnamese: Rõ. Tôi sẽ bố trí binh lính dẫn đường ngay.
data.Indonesian: Dimengerti. Saya akan segera menugaskan pengawal pemandu.

data.English: Good! I will check the gate checkpoint.
data.Thai: 좋아! 내가 관문 검문소를 확인할게.
data.Vietnamese: Tốt! Tôi sẽ kiểm tra trạm gác cổng.
data.Indonesian: Baik! Aku akan memeriksa pos gerbang.

data.English: I will check the tower first.
data.Thai: ฉันจะไปตรวจฝั่งหอคอยก่อน.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra phía tháp canh trước.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa menara dulu.

data.Korean: 신호석을 확인하고 나서, 세라 쪽을 도와줄게.
data.English: I will check the signal stones, then help Serah.
data.Thai: ฉันจะตรวจศิลาสัญญาณ แล้วไปช่วยเซราห์.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra đá tín hiệu rồi hỗ trợ Serah.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa batu sinyal, lalu membantu Serah.

data.Korean: 관문 안쪽 물자 보관소라면... 여기서 제일 멀지 않아?
data.English: If it is the supply storage inside the gate... is that not the farthest place from here?
data.Thai: ถ้าเป็นคลังเสบียงด้านในประตู... มันไกลที่สุดจากตรงนี้ไม่ใช่เหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Nếu là kho vật tư bên trong cổng... chẳng phải xa nhất từ đây sao?
data.Indonesian: Kalau gudang persediaan di dalam gerbang... bukankah itu yang paling jauh dari sini?

data.Korean: 멀어도 지금 봐두면 나중에 헤매지는 않을 거야.
data.English: Even if it is far, checking it now will keep us from getting lost later.
data.Thai: ถึงจะไกล แต่ถ้าดูไว้ตอนนี้ ทีหลังก็ไม่ต้องหลงทาง.
data.Vietnamese: Dù xa, kiểm tra bây giờ sẽ giúp sau này khỏi lạc đường.
data.Indonesian: Walau jauh, kalau dicek sekarang nanti kita tidak akan tersesat.

data.English: Serah, want to switch roles with me...?
data.Thai: เซราห์ อยากสลับหน้าที่กับฉันไหม...?
data.Vietnamese: Serah, có muốn đổi vai với tôi không...?
data.Indonesian: Serah, mau tukar tugas denganku...?

data.Korean: 미안. 검문소는 내가 보는 게 좋을 것 같아. 앞에서 막는 건 내 일이니까.
data.English: Sorry. I think I should handle the checkpoint. Stopping things at the front is my job.
data.Thai: ขอโทษนะ. ฉันว่าด่านตรวจให้ฉันดูน่าจะดีกว่า. การหยุดไว้ข้างหน้าเป็นงานของฉัน.
data.Vietnamese: Xin lỗi. Tôi nghĩ mình nên phụ trách trạm gác. Chặn ở phía trước là việc của tôi.
data.Indonesian: Maaf. Kurasa aku yang sebaiknya memeriksa pos. Menahan di depan itu tugasku.

data.English: That is so right it makes me even sadder...
data.Thai: ถูกต้องเกินไปจนยิ่งเศร้าเลย...
data.Vietnamese: Đúng quá nên càng buồn hơn...
data.Indonesian: Terlalu benar, jadi makin sedih...

data.Korean: (각자 위치를 확인하려던 순간, 요새 안쪽에서 경보 종이 크게 울렸다.)
data.English: (Just as we were about to check our positions, the alarm bell rang loudly inside the fortress.)
data.Thai: (ทันทีที่พวกเรากำลังจะแยกไปตรวจตำแหน่ง ระฆังเตือนภัยก็ดังลั่นจากในป้อม.)
data.Vietnamese: (Ngay lúc chúng tôi chuẩn bị kiểm tra vị trí của mình, chuông báo động trong pháo đài vang lớn.)
data.Indonesian: (Saat kami hendak memeriksa posisi masing-masing, lonceng peringatan di dalam benteng berbunyi keras.)

data.Korean: 보고드립니다! 몬스터 경보입니다! 숲 방향에서 다수의 몬스터를 확인했습니다! 관문 쪽으로 접근 중입니다!
data.English: Report! Monster alarm! We have confirmed many monsters from the forest! They are approaching the gate!
data.Thai: รายงานครับ! สัญญาณเตือนมอนสเตอร์! พบมอนสเตอร์จำนวนมากจากทางป่า! กำลังมุ่งหน้ามาที่ประตู!
data.Vietnamese: Báo cáo! Báo động quái vật! Đã phát hiện nhiều quái vật từ hướng rừng! Chúng đang tiến về phía cổng!
data.Indonesian: Lapor! Alarm monster! Banyak monster terdeteksi dari arah hutan! Mereka mendekati gerbang!

data.English: Serah... you said it was quiet.
data.Thai: เซราห์... เธอบอกว่าเงียบไม่ใช่เหรอ?
data.Vietnamese: Serah... cậu nói là yên tĩnh mà?
data.Indonesian: Serah... tadi kau bilang tenang, kan?

data.English: It was!
data.Thai: ก็เคยเงียบไง!
data.Vietnamese: Đã từng yên tĩnh mà!
data.Indonesian: Memang tadinya tenang!

data.Korean: 일단 다시 조용하게 만들 방법부터 생각하자.
data.English: First, let us think about how to make it quiet again.
data.Thai: ก่อนอื่น คิดวิธีทำให้มันเงียบอีกครั้งกันเถอะ.
data.Vietnamese: Trước hết, hãy nghĩ cách làm nơi này yên tĩnh lại đã.
data.Indonesian: Pertama, pikirkan cara membuatnya tenang lagi.

data.Korean: 노아는 망루에서 숲길을 계속 감시해 줘.
data.English: Noah, keep watching the forest road from the tower.
data.Thai: โนอา เฝ้าดูทางป่าจากหอคอยต่อไป.
data.Vietnamese: Noah, tiếp tục theo dõi đường rừng từ tháp canh.
data.Indonesian: Noah, terus awasi jalan hutan dari menara.

data.Korean: 스파인은 물자 보관소에서 응급 처치 물품을 챙겨와 줘. 둘 다 준비되는 대로 관문으로 합류해.
data.English: Spayin, bring first-aid supplies from the storage. Both of you, join us at the gate when ready.
data.Thai: สไปน์ เอาของปฐมพยาบาลจากคลังเสบียงมา. ทั้งสองคนพร้อมแล้วให้มารวมที่ประตู.
data.Vietnamese: Spayin, mang vật tư sơ cứu từ kho đến. Hai người chuẩn bị xong thì tập hợp ở cổng.
data.Indonesian: Spayin, ambil perlengkapan P3K dari gudang. Kalian berdua, bergabung di gerbang saat siap.

data.English: Okay. I will check and come right away.
data.Thai: อืม จะตรวจแล้วรีบไปทันที.
data.Vietnamese: Ừ, tôi sẽ kiểm tra rồi đến ngay.
data.Indonesian: Ya, aku cek lalu segera ke sana.

data.Korean: 윽... 힘들게 제일 먼 곳까지 왔는데 바로 돌아가야 하네.
data.English: Ugh... I came all the way to the farthest place, and now I have to go right back.
data.Thai: อึก... อุตส่าห์มาถึงที่ไกลที่สุดแล้ว ต้องกลับทันทีเลยเหรอ.
data.Vietnamese: Ư... vất vả lắm mới đến chỗ xa nhất, giờ lại phải quay về ngay.
data.Indonesian: Ugh... susah payah sampai tempat paling jauh, sekarang harus langsung kembali.

data.Korean: 세라와 엘리스 두 사람은 관문 검문소에서 몬스터를 먼저 막아줘.
data.English: Serah and Alice, the two of you stop the monsters at the gate checkpoint first.
data.Thai: เซราห์กับอลิซ ทั้งสองคนช่วยหยุดมอนสเตอร์ที่ด่านประตูก่อน.
data.Vietnamese: Serah và Alice, hai người chặn quái vật ở trạm gác cổng trước.
data.Indonesian: Serah dan Alice, kalian berdua hentikan monster dulu di pos gerbang.

data.Korean: 좋아! 여기는 내가 버틸게. 관문까지는 절대 못 지나가게 막을 거야!
data.English: Good! I will hold here. I will not let them get through to the gate!
data.Thai: 좋아! 여긴 내가 버틸게. 절대 관문까지 지나가게 두지 않아!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt! Tôi sẽ giữ chỗ này. Nhất định không cho chúng vượt qua tới cổng!
data.Indonesian: Baik! Aku akan bertahan di sini. Aku tidak akan membiarkan mereka melewati gerbang!

data.Korean: 세라가 앞을 맡아줘. 나는 적이 몰리는 쪽을 볼게.
data.English: Serah, take the front. I will handle the enemies that group up.
data.Thai: เซราห์ ฝากแนวหน้าให้เธอ. ฉันจะจัดการพวกที่รวมกันเป็นกลุ่ม.
data.Vietnamese: Serah, cậu lo phía trước. Tôi sẽ xử lý chỗ địch tụ lại.
data.Indonesian: Serah, ambil bagian depan. Aku akan menangani musuh yang berkumpul.

data.English: Got it. I will move out as soon as the signal comes!
data.Thai: 알겠어. สัญญาณมาเมื่อไหร่ ฉันจะออกไปทันที!
data.Vietnamese: Hiểu rồi. Tín hiệu đến là tôi sẽ lao ra ngay!
data.Indonesian: Mengerti. Begitu sinyal datang, aku langsung maju!

data.Korean: 몬스터 무리가 관문 앞까지 접근했습니다! 지휘관님, 신호석 준비를 부탁드립니다!
data.English: The monster horde has reached the gate! Commander, please prepare the signal stones!
data.Thai: ฝูงมอนสเตอร์เข้าใกล้หน้าประตูแล้วครับ! ท่านผู้บัญชาการ โปรดเตรียมศิลาสัญญาณ!
data.Vietnamese: Bầy quái vật đã áp sát trước cổng! Chỉ huy, xin chuẩn bị đá tín hiệu!
data.Indonesian: Gerombolan monster sudah mendekati gerbang! Komandan, tolong siapkan batu sinyal!

data.English: I will send the signal to Serah and Alice first.
data.Thai: ฉันจะส่งสัญญาณให้เซราห์กับอลิซก่อน.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ gửi tín hiệu cho Serah và Alice trước.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan mengirim sinyal ke Serah dan Alice dulu.

data.English: Signal link confirmed. Serah, are you ready?
data.Thai: ยืนยันการเชื่อมสัญญาณ. เซราห์ พร้อมไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Đã xác nhận kết nối tín hiệu. Serah, sẵn sàng chứ?
data.Indonesian: Koneksi sinyal terkonfirmasi. Serah, siap?

data.English: Good, here I go!
data.Thai: 좋아 ไปเลย!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt, tôi đi đây!
data.Indonesian: Baik, aku maju!

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 신호석 타이밍 액션 및 3-Sort 콤보 공격 학습]
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Learn signal stone timing actions and 3-Sort combo attacks]
data.Thai: [หน้าต่างสอนเล่น: เรียนรู้การกดจังหวะศิลาสัญญาณและคอมโบโจมตี 3-Sort]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Học thao tác căn thời gian đá tín hiệu và đòn combo 3-Sort]
data.Indonesian: [Popup Tutorial: Pelajari aksi timing batu sinyal dan serangan kombo 3-Sort]

data.English: Please drag the attack signal stone to Serah's slot.
data.Thai: กรุณาลากศิลาสัญญาณโจมตีไปยังสล็อตของเซราห์.
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kéo đá tín hiệu tấn công vào ô của Serah.
data.Indonesian: Silakan seret batu sinyal serangan ke slot Serah.

data.English: Please align three matching signal stones to complete a combo.
data.Thai: กรุณาจัดศิลาสัญญาณชนิดเดียวกัน 3 อันให้ตรงกันเพื่อทำคอมโบให้สำเร็จ.
data.Vietnamese: Hãy xếp 3 đá tín hiệu giống nhau để hoàn thành combo.
data.Indonesian: Susun 3 batu sinyal yang sama untuk menyelesaikan kombo.

data.Korean: 쏟아져 나오기 시작했어! 앞쪽은 내가 막을게!
data.English: They are pouring out! I will hold the front!
data.Thai: พวกมันทะลักออกมาแล้ว! ด้านหน้าฉันจะรับไว้เอง!
data.Vietnamese: Chúng bắt đầu tràn ra rồi! Phía trước để tôi chặn!
data.Indonesian: Mereka mulai menyerbu! Bagian depan akan kutahan!

data.English: If the enemies group up, I will deal with them.
data.Thai: ถ้าศัตรูรวมกัน ฉันจะจัดการเอง.
data.Vietnamese: Nếu địch tụ lại một chỗ, tôi sẽ xử lý.
data.Indonesian: Kalau musuh berkumpul, aku yang akan mengurusnya.

data.Korean: 두 번째 무리가 보여. 이제 나도 합류할게. 멀리서 다가오는 적은 내가 볼게.
data.English: I see the second wave. I will join now. I will watch the enemies coming from afar.
data.Thai: เห็นระลอกที่สองแล้ว. ฉันจะเข้าร่วมแล้วนะ. ศัตรูที่มาจากไกล ๆ ฉันจะดูเอง.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi thấy đợt thứ hai rồi. Giờ tôi sẽ tham gia. Kẻ địch từ xa để tôi theo dõi.
data.Indonesian: Aku melihat gelombang kedua. Aku bergabung sekarang. Musuh yang datang dari jauh akan kuawasi.

data.Korean: 물자 쪽 잠금은 확인했어. 붕대도 챙겼고.
data.English: The supply side is locked. I brought bandages too.
data.Thai: ฝั่งเสบียงล็อกเรียบร้อยแล้ว. ผ้าพันแผลก็เอามาแล้ว.
data.Vietnamese: Khu vật tư đã khóa rồi. Tôi cũng mang băng vải theo.
data.Indonesian: Bagian persediaan sudah terkunci. Perban juga kubawa.

data.English: Still, I am glad you came right away.
data.Thai: ยังไงก็ดีที่เธอมาทันทีนะ.
data.Vietnamese: Dù sao cậu đến ngay là tốt rồi.
data.Indonesian: Tetap saja, bagus kau langsung datang.

data.English: If I am late, I will only get busier...
data.Thai: ถ้าช้าไป งานจะยิ่งยุ่งกว่าเดิม...
data.Vietnamese: Nếu chậm thì tôi sẽ càng bận hơn...
data.Indonesian: Kalau terlambat, aku malah makin sibuk...

data.English: Good! Now everyone is here!
data.Thai: 좋아! 이제ครบทุกคนแล้ว!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt! Giờ mọi người đã đủ rồi!
data.Indonesian: Baik! Sekarang semua sudah berkumpul!

data.Korean: 이러면 다쳐도 바로 볼 수는 있겠지.
data.English: Now I can at least check on you right away if you get hurt.
data.Thai: แบบนี้ถ้ามีใครบาดเจ็บ ฉันก็ยังดูได้ทันที.
data.Vietnamese: Vậy nếu ai bị thương, ít nhất tôi có thể xem ngay.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begini, kalau ada yang terluka aku bisa langsung memeriksanya.

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 적 처치 경험치 획득 및 레벨업 보상 선택]
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Gain EXP by defeating enemies and choose a level-up reward]
data.Thai: [หน้าต่างสอนเล่น: ได้รับ EXP จากการกำจัดศัตรูและเลือกของรางวัลเลเวลอัป]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Nhận EXP khi đánh bại kẻ địch và chọn phần thưởng lên cấp]
data.Indonesian: [Popup Tutorial: Dapatkan EXP dengan mengalahkan musuh dan pilih hadiah naik level]

data.Korean: 레벨업 보상 카드 중 하나를 선택해주세요.
data.English: Please choose one level-up reward card.
data.Thai: กรุณาเลือกการ์ดรางวัลเลเวลอัป 1 ใบ.
data.Vietnamese: Hãy chọn một thẻ thưởng lên cấp.
data.Indonesian: Pilih salah satu kartu hadiah naik level.

data.English: Large monster/boss appears
data.Thai: มอนสเตอร์ขนาดใหญ่/บอสปรากฏตัว
data.Vietnamese: Quái vật lớn/Boss xuất hiện
data.Indonesian: Monster besar/boss muncul

data.Korean: 큰 녀석이 보여. 이번 무리는 저 녀석을 중심으로 움직이고 있어!
data.English: I see a big one. This wave is moving around that thing!
data.Thai: เห็นตัวใหญ่แล้ว. ระลอกนี้เคลื่อนที่โดยมีมันเป็นศูนย์กลาง!
data.Vietnamese: Tôi thấy một con lớn. Đợt này đang di chuyển xoay quanh nó!
data.Indonesian: Aku melihat yang besar. Gelombang ini bergerak berpusat pada makhluk itu!

data.Korean: 그럼 저 큰 녀석부터 막으면 되겠네. 내가 앞에 설게!
data.English: Then we just have to stop that big one first. I will stand at the front!
data.Thai: งั้นก็หยุดตัวใหญ่นั่นก่อนก็พอ. ฉันจะยืนแนวหน้าเอง!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chỉ cần chặn con lớn đó trước. Tôi sẽ đứng phía trước!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita hentikan yang besar dulu. Aku akan berdiri di depan!

data.Korean: 세라, 잠깐만! 저 덩치는 일반 공격만으로는 시간이 오래 걸릴 거야.
data.English: Serah, wait! That huge one will take too long with normal attacks.
data.Thai: เซราห์ เดี๋ยวก่อน! ตัวใหญ่นั่นถ้าใช้การโจมตีปกติจะใช้เวลานานเกินไป.
data.Vietnamese: Serah, khoan đã! Con to đó sẽ mất rất lâu nếu chỉ đánh thường.
data.Indonesian: Serah, tunggu! Yang besar itu akan terlalu lama jika hanya diserang biasa.

data.English: Commander, send Serah the skill signal!
data.Thai: ผู้บัญชาการ ส่งสัญญาณสกิลให้เซราห์!
data.Vietnamese: Chỉ huy, gửi tín hiệu kỹ năng cho Serah!
data.Indonesian: Komandan, kirim sinyal skill ke Serah!

data.Korean: 일반 신호가 아니라, 게이지를 전부 소모하는 필살기 신호야!
data.English: Not a normal signal. It is an ultimate signal that spends the full gauge!
data.Thai: ไม่ใช่สัญญาณธรรมดา. เป็นสัญญาณท่าไม้ตายที่ใช้เกจทั้งหมด!
data.Vietnamese: Không phải tín hiệu thường. Đây là tín hiệu tuyệt kỹ dùng toàn bộ thanh năng lượng!
data.Indonesian: Bukan sinyal biasa. Ini sinyal jurus pamungkas yang memakai seluruh gauge!

data.Korean: [튜토리얼 팝업: 게이지 소모를 통한 필살기(궁극기) 발동]
data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Use the gauge to activate a special skill/ultimate]
data.Thai: [หน้าต่างสอนเล่น: ใช้เกจเพื่อเปิดใช้สกิลพิเศษ/ท่าไม้ตาย]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Dùng thanh năng lượng để kích hoạt kỹ năng đặc biệt/tuyệt kỹ]
data.Indonesian: [Popup Tutorial: Gunakan gauge untuk mengaktifkan skill khusus/jurus pamungkas]

data.Korean: 필살기 게이지를 사용해 세라의 필살기를 발동해주세요.
data.English: Please use the Ultimate Gauge to activate Serah's ultimate.
data.Thai: กรุณาใช้เกจท่าไม้ตายเพื่อเปิดใช้ท่าไม้ตายของเซราห์.
data.Vietnamese: Hãy dùng thanh tuyệt kỹ để kích hoạt tuyệt kỹ của Serah.
data.Indonesian: Gunakan Gauge Pamungkas untuk mengaktifkan jurus pamungkas Serah.

data.Korean: 신호 확인! 크게 한 방 먹일게!
data.English: Signal confirmed! I will hit it with one big blow!
data.Thai: ยืนยันสัญญาณ! จะอัดให้เต็มแรงสักที!
data.Vietnamese: Đã nhận tín hiệu! Tôi sẽ tung một đòn thật mạnh!
data.Indonesian: Sinyal diterima! Akan kuhajar dengan satu pukulan besar!

data.English: (We defeated all the monsters in front of the gate.)
data.Thai: (พวกเรากำจัดมอนสเตอร์หน้าประตูได้ทั้งหมดแล้ว.)
data.Vietnamese: (Chúng tôi đã đánh bại toàn bộ quái vật trước cổng.)
data.Indonesian: (Kami mengalahkan semua monster di depan gerbang.)

data.Korean: 다친 데는 없어? 무리하지 말고 바로 말해줘.
data.English: Is anyone hurt? If something hurts, tell me right away.
data.Thai: มีใครบาดเจ็บไหม? ถ้าเจ็บตรงไหนรีบบอกทันทีนะ.
data.Vietnamese: Có ai bị thương không? Nếu đau chỗ nào thì nói ngay nhé.
data.Indonesian: Ada yang terluka? Kalau ada yang sakit, segera bilang.

data.Korean: 없어! 다친 데는 없어! 관문 앞 돌바닥은... 음, 괜찮겠지?
data.English: No! I am not hurt! The stone ground by the gate is... well, probably fine?
data.Thai: ไม่มี! ฉันไม่เจ็บตรงไหน! พื้นหินหน้าประตูน่ะ... อืม คงไม่เป็นไรหรอกมั้ง?
data.Vietnamese: Không! Tôi không bị thương! Nền đá trước cổng thì... ừm, chắc là ổn nhỉ?
data.Indonesian: Tidak! Aku tidak terluka! Lantai batu di depan gerbang... yah, mungkin baik-baik saja?

data.Korean: 괜찮겠지로 끝낼 이야기는 아닌데, 뭐 그래도 몬스터는 관문에 닿기 전에 끊어냈어.
data.English: Probably fine is not really an answer, but at least we stopped the monsters before they reached the gate.
data.Thai: จบด้วยคำว่าคงไม่เป็นไรไม่ได้หรอกนะ แต่ยังไงเราก็ตัดพวกมอนสเตอร์ก่อนถึงประตูได้.
data.Vietnamese: Nói chắc là ổn thì chưa đủ đâu, nhưng dù sao ta đã chặn quái vật trước khi chúng chạm tới cổng.
data.Indonesian: “Mungkin baik-baik saja” bukan jawaban, tapi setidaknya kita menghentikan monster sebelum mencapai gerbang.

data.Korean: 돌바닥은 내가 확인해 둘게. 나중에 수리 일이 커지면 더 귀찮아지니까.
data.English: I will check the stone ground. If repairs get bigger later, it will be more annoying.
data.Thai: ฉันจะตรวจพื้นหินไว้ก่อน. ถ้างานซ่อมใหญ่ขึ้นทีหลังจะยุ่งกว่าเดิม.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra nền đá. Nếu sau này việc sửa chữa lớn hơn thì phiền lắm.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa lantai batunya. Kalau perbaikan jadi besar nanti, akan lebih merepotkan.

data.Korean: 그런데 좀 이상해. 아까 그 몬스터 무리, 전부 숲길에서 내려왔어.
data.English: But something is strange. That monster group all came down from the forest road.
data.Thai: แต่มันแปลกอยู่นะ. ฝูงมอนสเตอร์เมื่อกี้ทั้งหมดลงมาจากทางป่า.
data.Vietnamese: Nhưng có gì đó lạ. Đám quái vật vừa rồi đều đi xuống từ đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Tapi ada yang aneh. Gerombolan monster tadi semuanya turun dari jalan hutan.

data.Korean: 망루에서 봤을 때, 숲길 안쪽 움직임이 아직 남아 있었어.
data.English: When I looked from the tower, there was still movement deeper in the forest road.
data.Thai: ตอนมองจากหอคอย ยังเห็นความเคลื่อนไหวลึกเข้าไปในทางป่าอยู่.
data.Vietnamese: Khi nhìn từ tháp canh, tôi vẫn thấy chuyển động sâu bên trong đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Saat kulihat dari menara, masih ada pergerakan lebih dalam di jalan hutan.

data.English: Then we need to check the forest road again.
data.Thai: งั้นต้องตรวจทางป่าอีกครั้งแล้ว.
data.Vietnamese: Vậy chúng ta phải kiểm tra lại đường rừng.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita harus memeriksa jalan hutan lagi.

data.Korean: 시에스가 원래 이렇게 몬스터가 몰려드는 곳은 아니야.
data.English: Cies is not normally a place where monsters swarm like this.
data.Thai: ปกติซีเอสไม่ใช่ที่ที่มอนสเตอร์แห่มากันแบบนี้.
data.Vietnamese: Bình thường Cies không phải nơi quái vật kéo đến đông như vậy.
data.Indonesian: Biasanya Cies bukan tempat yang didatangi monster sebanyak ini.

data.Korean: 조용한 근무지라더니, 그 소문이 완전히 틀렸네.
data.English: They said it was a quiet post, but that rumor was completely wrong.
data.Thai: บอกว่าเป็นจุดประจำการเงียบ ๆ แต่นั่นผิดหมดเลย.
data.Vietnamese: Nghe nói đây là nơi trực yên tĩnh, nhưng tin đồn đó sai hoàn toàn rồi.
data.Indonesian: Katanya ini pos yang tenang, tapi rumor itu benar-benar salah.

data.Korean: 그 소문을 제일 먼저 말한 사람이 세라였지.
data.English: The first person to say that rumor was Serah.
data.Thai: คนแรกที่พูดข่าวลือนั้นคือเซราห์นะ.
data.Vietnamese: Người đầu tiên nói tin đồn đó là Serah đấy.
data.Indonesian: Orang pertama yang mengatakan rumor itu adalah Serah.

data.Korean: 그럼 내가 직접 확인해서 정정하면 되겠네!
data.English: Then I can check it myself and correct it!
data.Thai: งั้นฉันจะตรวจเองแล้วแก้ข่าวให้ถูกต้อง!
data.Vietnamese: Vậy tôi sẽ tự kiểm tra rồi đính chính lại!
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, aku akan memeriksanya sendiri dan meluruskannya!

data.English: Wait, I see something in front of the gate.
data.Thai: เดี๋ยวก่อน ฉันเห็นอะไรบางอย่างหน้าประตู.
data.Vietnamese: Khoan đã, tôi thấy có gì đó trước cổng.
data.Indonesian: Tunggu, aku melihat sesuatu di depan gerbang.

data.Korean: 몬스터들이 지나간 자리에 빛나는 게 남아 있어.
data.English: Something shining was left where the monsters passed.
data.Thai: มีบางอย่างส่องแสงอยู่ตรงรอยที่มอนสเตอร์ผ่านไป.
data.Vietnamese: Có thứ gì đó phát sáng ở nơi quái vật vừa đi qua.
data.Indonesian: Ada sesuatu yang bersinar di tempat monster lewat.

data.English: You are right. Something is shining!
data.Thai: จริงด้วย. มีอะไรบางอย่างส่องแสงอยู่!
data.Vietnamese: Đúng thật. Có thứ gì đó đang phát sáng!
data.Indonesian: Benar. Ada sesuatu yang bersinar!

data.English: I do not want to touch it carelessly and make more work...
data.Thai: ไม่อยากแตะสุ่มสี่สุ่มห้าแล้วเพิ่มงานหรอก...
data.Vietnamese: Tôi không muốn chạm bừa rồi làm việc tăng thêm đâu...
data.Indonesian: Aku tidak mau sembarangan menyentuhnya lalu menambah pekerjaan...

data.English: Alice, can you check it for me?
data.Thai: อลิซ ช่วยตรวจให้หน่อยได้ไหม?
data.Vietnamese: Alice, cậu kiểm tra giúp được không?
data.Indonesian: Alice, bisa tolong periksa?

data.Korean: 응. 확인해 봤는데 문제는 없어 보여.
data.English: Yes. I checked it, and it does not seem dangerous.
data.Thai: อืม. ตรวจดูแล้ว ดูเหมือนไม่มีปัญหา.
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Tôi đã kiểm tra, có vẻ không có vấn đề gì.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Sudah kuperiksa, sepertinya tidak berbahaya.

data.English: It feels similar to a signal stone reaction, but a little different.
data.Thai: ปฏิกิริยาคล้ายศิลาสัญญาณ แต่ต่างออกไปเล็กน้อย.
data.Vietnamese: Phản ứng hơi giống đá tín hiệu, nhưng có chút khác.
data.Indonesian: Reaksinya mirip batu sinyal, tapi sedikit berbeda.

data.English: This is a relic.
data.Thai: นี่คือวัตถุโบราณ.
data.Vietnamese: Đây là di vật.
data.Indonesian: Ini relik.

data.English: [Tutorial Popup: Choose a relic reward]
data.Thai: [หน้าต่างสอนเล่น: เลือกรางวัลวัตถุโบราณ]
data.Vietnamese: [Cửa sổ hướng dẫn: Chọn phần thưởng di vật]
data.Indonesian: [Popup Tutorial: Pilih hadiah relik]

data.Korean: 유물 효과는 다음 스테이지에도 유지됩니다. 3개 중 1개를 선택해주세요.
data.English: Relic effects carry over to the next stage. Please choose one of the three.
data.Thai: เอฟเฟกต์วัตถุโบราณจะคงอยู่ในสเตจถัดไป. กรุณาเลือก 1 จาก 3 ชิ้น.
data.Vietnamese: Hiệu ứng di vật sẽ được giữ sang màn tiếp theo. Hãy chọn 1 trong 3.
data.Indonesian: Efek relik akan tetap berlaku ke stage berikutnya. Pilih 1 dari 3.

data.English: Then we should choose carefully.
data.Thai: งั้นต้องเลือกให้รอบคอบแล้ว.
data.Vietnamese: Vậy phải chọn cẩn thận rồi.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, kita harus memilih dengan hati-hati.

data.Korean: 그럼 앞에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있는 세라와 관련된 게 좋겠네.
data.English: Then something related to Serah, so she can hold the front longer, would be good.
data.Thai: งั้นเลือกของที่เกี่ยวกับเซราห์ดีกว่า เพื่อให้เธอยืนแนวหน้าได้นานขึ้น.
data.Vietnamese: Vậy thứ liên quan đến Serah, giúp cô ấy trụ phía trước lâu hơn, sẽ tốt đấy.
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, yang berkaitan dengan Serah agar ia bisa bertahan lebih lama di depan akan bagus.

data.Korean: 숲길은 시야가 좁아. 세라가 앞을 버텨주면 모두 움직이기 편할 거야.
data.English: The forest road has poor visibility. If Serah holds the front, everyone can move more easily.
data.Thai: ทางป่ามองเห็นได้แคบ. ถ้าเซราห์ยืนแนวหน้า ทุกคนจะขยับง่ายขึ้น.
data.Vietnamese: Đường rừng có tầm nhìn hẹp. Nếu Serah giữ phía trước, mọi người sẽ dễ di chuyển hơn.
data.Indonesian: Jalan hutan memiliki jarak pandang sempit. Jika Serah menahan bagian depan, semua orang bisa bergerak lebih mudah.

data.Korean: 고대 갑옷을 획득했습니다. 이후 스테이지에도 효과가 유지됩니다.
data.English: Ancient Armor acquired. Its effect will remain in later stages.
data.Thai: ได้รับเกราะโบราณแล้ว. เอฟเฟกต์จะคงอยู่ในสเตจถัดไป.
data.Vietnamese: Đã nhận Áo Giáp Cổ Đại. Hiệu ứng sẽ được giữ ở các màn sau.
data.Indonesian: Ancient Armor diperoleh. Efeknya akan tetap berlaku di stage berikutnya.

data.Korean: 선택됐어. 이 효과는 다음 전투에도 남아.
data.English: Selected. This effect will remain in the next battle too.
data.Thai: เลือกแล้ว. เอฟเฟกต์นี้จะคงอยู่ในการต่อสู้ครั้งถัดไปด้วย.
data.Vietnamese: Đã chọn. Hiệu ứng này cũng sẽ còn trong trận tiếp theo.
data.Indonesian: Terpilih. Efek ini juga akan tetap ada di pertempuran berikutnya.

data.Korean: 숲길부터 확인해 보자. 노아, 몬스터가 지나간 흔적을 따라가 줘.
data.English: Let us check the forest road first. Noah, follow the traces left by the monsters.
data.Thai: มาตรวจทางป่าก่อนเถอะ. โนอา ตามร่องรอยที่มอนสเตอร์ทิ้งไว้.
data.Vietnamese: Hãy kiểm tra đường rừng trước. Noah, lần theo dấu vết quái vật để lại.
data.Indonesian: Mari kita periksa jalan hutan dulu. Noah, ikuti jejak yang ditinggalkan monster.

data.Korean: 응. 지나간 흔적은 아직 남아 있어. 따라가 볼게.
data.English: Okay. The traces are still there. I will follow them.
data.Thai: อืม. ร่องรอยยังเหลืออยู่. ฉันจะตามไปดู.
data.Vietnamese: Ừ. Dấu vết vẫn còn. Tôi sẽ lần theo.
data.Indonesian: Ya. Jejaknya masih ada. Aku akan mengikutinya.

data.Korean: 나는 신호석 상태를 다시 볼게. 다음 무리가 오기 전에 맞춰둬야 하니까.
data.English: I will check the signal stone condition again. We need to tune them before the next group comes.
data.Thai: ฉันจะตรวจสภาพศิลาสัญญาณอีกครั้ง. ต้องปรับให้พร้อมก่อนกลุ่มถัดไปมา.
data.Vietnamese: Tôi sẽ kiểm tra lại trạng thái đá tín hiệu. Phải chỉnh lại trước khi đợt tiếp theo đến.
data.Indonesian: Aku akan memeriksa kondisi batu sinyal lagi. Kita harus menyesuaikannya sebelum gerombolan berikutnya datang.

data.Korean: 좋아! 원인을 찾고, 조용한 근무지도 되찾자!
data.English: Good! Let us find the cause and get our quiet post back!
data.Thai: 좋아! 원인을 찾고 จุดประจำการเงียบ ๆ ของเรากลับคืนมาเถอะ!
data.Vietnamese: Tốt! Hãy tìm nguyên nhân và lấy lại nơi trực yên tĩnh của chúng ta!
data.Indonesian: Baik! Ayo cari penyebabnya dan rebut kembali pos tenang kita!

data.Korean: 그럼 지금 움직이자. 멀리까진 안 가도 되겠지...
data.English: Then let us move now. We will not have to go too far, right...
data.Thai: งั้นตอนนี้ขยับกันเถอะ. คงไม่ต้องไปไกลมากใช่ไหม...
data.Vietnamese: Vậy đi ngay thôi. Chắc sẽ không phải đi xa lắm đâu nhỉ...
data.Indonesian: Kalau begitu, bergerak sekarang. Kita tidak perlu pergi terlalu jauh, kan...

data.English: Please say we do not have to go...
data.Thai: ช่วยบอกทีว่าไม่ต้องไปนะ...
data.Vietnamese: Làm ơn nói là không phải đi đi...
data.Indonesian: Tolong bilang kita tidak perlu pergi...

data.Korean: (관문 앞의 소란은 끝났지만, 숲 쪽의 움직임은 아직 멈추지 않은 것 같았다.)
data.English: (The commotion at the gate had ended, but the movement in the forest had not stopped yet.)
data.Thai: (ความวุ่นวายหน้าประตูจบลงแล้ว แต่ความเคลื่อนไหวในป่ายังไม่หยุด.)
data.Vietnamese: (Sự hỗn loạn trước cổng đã kết thúc, nhưng chuyển động trong rừng vẫn chưa dừng lại.)
data.Indonesian: (Keributan di depan gerbang telah berakhir, tetapi pergerakan di hutan belum berhenti.)
